Priya R.: FYI opened PR to reconcile console presets docs + tracing hook rename + a short note on cost/latency breakdowns. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :wave:
Gabe: nice. did you update the example keys? runtime changed metric name to cost_per_k_tokens last sprint.
Marta: also check the dashboard quickstart — product wants the small metric card as primary example, not the big table.
Priya R.: updated keys in the PR and swapped the examples order. left the table as advanced.
ci-bot: build failed 1 broken links: /console/metrics/old-presets -> 404, /sdk/js/old-get -> 404.
Theo: i can add a redirect for the old-presets path in the router. will raise a tiny PR to docs-router.
Rochelle: for the JS snippet, use an async IIFE instead of top-level await so it runs in more environments. also include a short comment about median vs p95 latency.
Priya R.: good catches. swapping JS to IIFE and adding the median note. including a Go snippet per ops request (very small).
Gabe: quick nit on wording: current header says "cost/latency tradeoffs" 1 prefer "cost and latency breakdown (guidance for preset selection)". clearer for non-infra folks.
Marta: add a one-line migration checklist at top: rename keys, update dashboards, add redirects. makes rollout smoother for infra and partners.
Priya R.: adding checklist and a callout: "Quantized models may alter per-token cost; run deployment benchmarks for precise numbers."
ci-bot: rebuild queued 1 re-run requested by Priya R.
Theo: once redirect is merged ill ping infra to update any internal links.
Rochelle: LGTM on snippets after the IIFE change. small copy edit: change "recommended" -> "recommended when latency is a priority".
Priya R.: applied edits and pushed. thanks everyone  merging after green CI. :tada:
